metaTitle: Video Trimmer - Cut a Video in Your Browser (Free) | ReelFlow Toolkit
description: Choose a start and end time and download just that part of the video. The clip is recorded on your device with no upload.
ogTitle: Video Trimmer - Cut a Clip Without Uploading
ogDescription: Trim any video to the seconds you need and download the clip, all inside your browser.
ldDescription: Trim a video by choosing start and end times; the browser records the chosen section locally.
lede: Load a video, set the start and end, and download just that part. The file is processed on your device - nothing is uploaded.

faq.a: The clip starts at the time you set and stops at the end you set, to the nearest recorded frame. Unlike a fast copy cut, there is no keyframe limitation.
The chosen section is recorded as it plays, so a 40-second clip takes about 40 seconds. Keep the tab open and in front until it finishes; there is no encoder to download.
Any video the browser can play - MP4 with H.264 works everywhere, while MOV and MKV depend on the browser's codecs. Chrome saves MP4; other browsers save WebM.

related.note: Turn the cut into a loop
